tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. The default canvas for every surface; Night is the house theme.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Product-image wells, footer, quiet bands that sit one step off `ground`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, drawers, the cart sheet, active tab fill. Pair with `shadow-overlay` only when it floats.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between grid cells, sections and table rows. Decorative only, never a control border.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: input underline, size chips, unselected tabs. ≥3:1 on `ground`, `surface`, `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, wordmark and outline-button borders on `ground`, `surface`, `surface-raised` (≥13:1 both themes). Bone, not pure white.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: body paragraphs under display type, price, captions, nav at rest. ≥6:1 on all three grounds.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels, legal footer. ≥4.5:1 on all three grounds, but reserve it for text people may skip.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The crown, and one gold element per view: a gold CTA, a heading rule, the hero glint, The Code's numerals or the QuoteBand crest. The logo mark and the focus ring never count. Sampled from the logo foil in Night; darkened in Bone to hold 5:1 as text.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `gold` fills; engraved rules on gold; the outlined numerals of The Code and the crest's foil.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on `gold` or `gold-deep` fills (≥5.8:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Sold out, form errors, low stock. Always with a word ("Sold out"). Orange, so it never relies on red/green hue alone.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: In stock, order confirmed, promo applied. Steel blue, told apart from `danger` by hue family and always labelled.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero wordmark, one or two words, UPPERCASE, never wrapping. 56px on a phone, 128px at 1440px. Fluid: phone size at 390px, desktop size at 1440px.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section statements ("More than a game.") and the mobile menu's links. UPPERCASE. Fluid: phone size at 390px, desktop size at 1440px.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section titles: Built to be worn hard, Choose your seat. UPPERCASE. Fluid: phone size at 390px, desktop size at 1440px.

styles.name: title-l
styles.usage: Choose your seat tile titles: a Drop or Category name. UPPERCASE. Fluid: phone size at 390px, desktop size at 1440px.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Product page name, cart sheet title. UPPERCASE.

styles.name: quote-l
styles.usage: The QuoteBand line. Sentence case, italic, balanced. Fluid: phone size at 390px, desktop size at 1440px.
styles.sample: The table doesn’t build character. It reveals it.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: The hero tagline. Sentence case, italic. Fluid: phone size at 390px, desktop size at 1440px.
styles.sample: Master yourself before you master the table.

styles.name: body-l
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under a display statement. Max 56ch.
styles.sample: Poker isn't just cards — it's a mirror.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default copy, product descriptions, form help.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav, product names on cards, tabs. UPPERCASE.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The tracked line above a heading and the value lists (PATIENCE / DISCIPLINE). UPPERCASE.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices and quantities. Use tabular numerals (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The Code's Roman numerals in the phone list. Outlined: a 0.8px gold-deep stroke, no fill, optical size 96.

styles.name: numeral-l
styles.usage: The Code's Roman numerals in the five-column row from 1024px. Outlined as `numeral`.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Space is the luxury: when in doubt, take the next step up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: name → price on a card.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip padding, list item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; control padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card text inset; gap between product cards on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; eyebrow → heading block gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between product cards on desktop; heading → grid.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Inside a band, top and bottom on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section rhythm on desktop: band top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero and manifesto bands; the pause before a statement.

radius.note: Square by default. The brand is cut, not rounded.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, cards, inputs, images, tiles.

tokens.name: radius-hair
tokens.usage: Only badges and the focus ring, to soften a small shape.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Colour swatch dots and the cart count. Never on buttons.

shadow.note: No elevation on the page. One shadow, for things that float over it.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Cart drawer, menus, modals on `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width; full-bleed imagery ignores it.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Header height at every width, and the homepage hero's clearance under the floating header.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and rule. There is no 2px border.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for body copy.
